olivia: Heads up — the JavaScript sample app started crashing in the Edge preview after the latest package.json change that added a strict `exports` map. stack: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined` followed by `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` when bundling for the edge runtime.

sam: ugh. Is this the change where we removed `main` and only left conditional `exports`? can you paste the error and your package.json?

olivia: error dump: ```Error: Unexpected token 'export'
 at new Script (internal/vm.js:85:7)
 at createScript (vm.js:264:10)
 at Object.runInThisContext (vm.js:312:10)
 at Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:1158:28)
 at Object.Module._extensions..js (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:1192:10)
 at Module.load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:1016:32)
```
package.json snippet: ```json
{"name":"@redwood/sdk-sample","version":"0.1.0","exports":{"./feature":{"import":"./dist/feature.mjs","require":"./dist/feature.cjs"}},"types":"dist/index.d.ts"}
```

kevin: Looks like the edge bundler is pulling the wrong entrypoint for some consumers — when a consumer does `require('@redwood/sdk-sample')` older Node/CJS consumers (and some bundlers) still try to read package.json if `"./package.json"` isn't explicitly exported. Also some edge runtimes (and bun) are stricter about ESM/CJS interop.

maria: Another wrinkle: TypeScript's `types` resolution still works via the top-level `types` field, but some consumers import a subpath and end up with a file that expects ESM. So a downstream CJS app doing `require('@redwood/sdk-sample/feature')` can end up pulling the .mjs in dist if exports aren't exhaustive.

olivia: Repro command: `node -v` -> v16.20.0, but the preview image uses `edge-runtime@latest` which behaves like newer V8 but different resolution semantics. CI shows failing tests for sample-app: `ci-bot` flagged it.

ci-bot: test-suite/sample-app — failed on linux-edge (matrix: node16/edge) — 3/3 failed. See https://ci.internal/12345

sam: Quick mitigation: add a fallback export for the package root and explicit `"./package.json"` export so tooling/bundlers can find metadata. Proposed exports block: ```json
{"exports": {".":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"./package.json":"./package.json","./feature":{"import":"./dist/feature.mjs","require":"./dist/feature.cjs"}}}
```

kevin: also ensure we ship both `dist/index.cjs` and `dist/index.mjs` in the package tarball, and keep a top-level `main` fallback for older tooling (some older packagers still read `main`). eg add `"main":"dist/index.cjs","module":"dist/index.mjs"`.

maria: For typings, keep `types":"dist/index.d.ts"` top-level. If we split subpaths with own .d.ts files, add `types` entries in the package or include `./feature.d.ts` next to compiled artifacts.

olivia: I can open a small patch: add `./package.json` export + `main` + publish a canary artifact to npm (or local `npm pack`) so we can validate CI. Will that fix the edge bundle?

sam: yes, do that. Also add a short note in the changelog/RELEASE_NOTES about the exports map to warn integrators.

kevin: Long-term: we should add a devex checklist for package.json exports changes — include: smoke test on node 12/14/16/18, bun, edge runtime, `npm pack` sanity, and verify `require()` and `import()` consumers work. Also add a tiny sample for both CJS and ESM imports.

maria: FYI I hit a related problem in onboarding guide where the sample code used `const r = require('@redwood/sdk-sample')` and CI was green until exports changed. So we should update docs to show both `import` and `require` variants.

olivia: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/678 — includes exports fallback and `main`/`module` fields. running `npm pack` locally and testing in sample-app now

ci-bot: PR 678 — smoke tests (edge matrix) queued.

sam: If CI passes, ship a patch release and ping GA/marketing slack so customers with pinned versions can choose to upgrade. Also add an internal note to product about the potential breaking change so support can triage incoming tickets quickly.

kevin: Thanks — once merged we should run `npx browserify`/`rollup` on the sample-app to verify bundler edge cases too.

olivia: cool — will follow up with results in this thread. Thanks all :+1:
